name: local-reader
description: legado 本地 TXT 阅读器复刻（Tauri 2.x + Vue 3）

scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run server:dev" "npm run dev:web:ui"
scripts.build:web: npm run version:apply && npm run build:wasm && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode web
scripts.build:web:prebuilt: npm run version:apply && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode web
scripts.preview:web: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run server:start" "npm run preview:web:ui"
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && npm run server:deploy
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run server:check && npm run server:test && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p local-reader
scripts.android:dev: npm run version:apply && tauri android dev
scripts.android:debug: npm run version:apply && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/build-android.ps1 -Target split
scripts.android:release: npm run version:apply && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/build-android.ps1 -Target split -Release -SizeOptimized
